# technitium_blocked_zone (Resource)

Blocks a domain and all its subdomains, in addition to block lists from `technitium_settings_blocking`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "technitium_blocked_zone" "ads" {
  for_each = toset(["ads.example.com", "tracker.example.net"])
  domain   = each.value
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name, e.g. `ads.example.com`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Domain name; also the import ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import technitium_blocked_zone.ads ads.example.com
```
